Assign_Every_task_to_a_Lead_or_Opp: When a Call task is saved without a related record type or branch (or not linked to a Lead/Opportunity), finds the Lead or open Opportunity (by Id or by the phone number at the end of the subject) and sets WhoId/WhatId, Branch__c and RecordType_related__c. Note: one decision checks WhoId against the Opportunity prefix 006 instead of the Lead prefix 00Q.
Assign_record_type_Opp_related_to_contac: When an Opportunity's record type changes, asynchronously loops its contact roles and appends Realtor, Loan Officer or Broker to each Contact's RecordTypes_related__c multi-select. Note: the Broker and Loan Officer 'already exists' checks test for 'Realtor' (copy-paste bug), and it branches on RecordType.DeveloperName.

When an OpportunityContactRole is created, asynchronously appends the Opportunity's record type (Realtor, Loan Officer or Broker) to the Contact's RecordTypes_related__c multi-select. Note: the Broker and Loan Officer 'already exists' checks test for 'Realtor' (copy-paste bug).
Assign_subtype_to_tasks: When a Task is saved with a blank or 'Task Other' Subtype__c, sets Subtype__c (SMS, Call, Email Sent/Failed/Opened/Link Clicked/Marked as Spam/Unsubscribed, Meeting or Task Other) from the subject text and standard TaskSubtype.
Assignment_of_tasks_without_record: When a Task is created or updated with neither WhoId nor WhatId, asynchronously sends the Task Id to the external service AssignmentRecord.ValidationTask so it can be linked to a record.
Batch_Assign_Lead_Role: Screen flow launched from a Lead list view (admins or users with the Batch_Assign_Lead_Role permission) that sets Sales Agent, Co-Owner, Owner, Loan Officer, Referred By (plus date) or NPPM Realtor on up to 200 selected Leads, running in system mode without sharing.
Chatter_to_Contacted_Flow: When a Chatter post on a Lead or Opportunity is created or edited and its body contains a keyword (credit, tax, itin, trabajo, etc.), sets Contacted__c = true on that Lead or Opportunity. Note: fragment keywords like 'ia' and 'ash' match almost any text, so nearly every post qualifies.
Create_Borrower_Lead_from_Realtor_Opport: Screen flow on an Opportunity that collects a borrower's name, 10-digit phone and email, then creates a Borrower Lead (source Referral) with the Opportunity's owner and branch, referred by its primary contact role.
Create_Lead_from_Opportunity: Screen flow on a Closed Lost Opportunity that, after confirmation and an email duplicate check, creates a Recruitment-branch Lead (hard-coded record type Id) copying name, contact, NMLS, PPS and productivity-link data.
Create_NPPM_On_Realtor_Closed_Won: When a Realtor Opportunity with NPPM__c = true becomes Closed Won, creates one NPPM__c record (name, brokerage, email, phone, role, owner, source opportunity) unless one already exists for it.
Date_of_update_status_movement: When a Lead's Status changes, stamps Status_movement_date__c with the current date/time.
First_Touch_with_Chatter: When a Chatter post is created on an Opportunity, Lead or Task: for an open 'Document Follow Up' task it moves the due date 2 business days out and sets Touch Type = Follow Up; otherwise it completes the poster's oldest open touch task on that record.
First_Touch_with_Tasks: When a non-admin user creates a Task on a Lead or Opportunity, sets Last_Action_Date__c to today on that Lead or Opportunity. Note: the flow label says 'Last Action Date with Tasks', not the API name.
Get_Realtor_Insights: Screen flow (label 'Get Agent Insights') on a Lead that, after the user confirms, sets AI_Trigger__c = true to start AI research on that agent.
LOA2_Notify_Closing_Milestone: When Closing_Milestone_Date__c is set on an Opportunity of record type 012Kb000000RpDEIA0, emails a 'Closing Milestone Finished' notice to the Loan Officer, LOA2 and Loan Processor. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Notify_Funding_Milestone: When Funding_Milestone_Date__c is set on an Opportunity of record type 012Kb000000RpDEIA0, emails a 'Funding Milestone Completed' notice to the Loan Officer, LOA2 and Loan Processor. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_Appraisal_POD: When Appraisal_Received_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails LO/LOA2/Processor and, if LOA2 is assigned, creates a 3-business-day 'Appraisal received - POD' Mortgage_Condition__c work item. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_Close_Appraisal_POD: When an Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0) gets an Appraisal_Proof_of_Delivery_Date__c, marks its open 'Appraisal received - POD' Mortgage_Condition__c work items Completed.
LOA2_Task_Close_On_CTC: When Clear_to_Close_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails a Clear-to-Close congratulation to LO/LOA2/Processor and completes open 'File resubmitted to UW' work items. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_IPR_Wait: When Submitted_to_Processing_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails LO/LOA2/Processor and, if LOA2 is assigned, creates a 1-business-day 'Waiting for Processor - IPR review' Mortgage_Condition__c work item. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_Initial_Decision: When Initial_UW_Decision_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails LO/LOA2/Processor and, if LOA2 is assigned, completes the 'File submitted to UW' item and creates a 2-business-day 'Initial decision received' work item. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_Resubmitted_To_Processing: On Opportunity update (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0, open, LOA2 assigned), completes open 'File resubmitted to UW' items and creates a 2-business-day 'Resubmitted to processing - awaiting LP conditions' work item. (fires when Resubmitted_Date__c is cleared — by design, the counterpart of LOA2_Task_Resubmitted_To_UW).
LOA2_Task_Resubmitted_To_UW: When Resubmitted_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails LO/LOA2/Processor and, if LOA2 is assigned, completes Initial-decision and Resubmitted-to-processing items and creates a 2-business-day 'File resubmitted to UW' work item. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
LOA2_Task_Submitted_To_UW: When Submitted_to_UW_Date__c is set on an open Opportunity (RT 012Kb000000RpDEIA0), emails LO/LOA2/Processor and, if LOA2 is assigned, completes the IPR Wait item and creates a 2-business-day 'File submitted to UW' work item. Note: non-test recipients always include two hard-coded Production Support addresses (Test_Mode__c redirects all to the test recipient).
Last_Action_Date_with_Last_Mod_Date_Lead: Before any Lead is created or updated by a non-admin user, sets Last_Action_Date__c to today.
Last_Action_Date_with_Last_Modified_Date: Before any Opportunity is created or updated by a non-admin user, sets Last_Action_Date__c to today.
Last_Action_with_Chatter: When a Chatter post is created on an Opportunity or Lead by a non-admin user, stamps today's date into that record's Last_Action_Date__c.
Last_Action_with_Event: When a calendar Event is created against an Opportunity (WhatId) or Lead (WhoId) by a non-admin user, stamps today's date into that record's Last_Action_Date__c. Note: an unused PhoneNumber formula and three unused variables are left over.
Lead_Status_Date_Tracker: On Lead create/update, stamps today's date into New_Date__c, Working_Date__c, On_hold_Date__c, discarded_date__c or Qualified_Date__c the first time the Lead reaches that Status.
No_Contacted_Reasons_for_discarding: On Lead create/update, when Reasons_for_discarding__c is 'Unresponsive' or Notes__c contains 'no contest', sets Contacted__c to false. Note: can conflict with Notes_Review_for_Contact_Flow, which sets the same field true on keyword matches.
Notes_Review_for_Contact_Flow: On every Lead create/update, sets Contacted__c to true when Notes__c or Jungo_Notes__c contains keywords like itin, tax, credit, cash, zelle, trabajo or social. Note: no entry criteria and loose substrings (e.g. 'cia', 'tax') cause frequent self-updates and false matches.
Notify_Removal_from_Opportunity_Team: Before an LOA-role Opportunity Team member whose User Division contains 'Support on Demand' is removed, deletes their Tasks on that Opportunity with 'Loan' in the subject and emails them a removal notice. Note: CCs two hard-coded external addresses at another company's domain.
OldData_contact_Role: One-time scheduled batch (2025-04-14) over OpportunityContactRole that appends Realtor, Loan Officer or Broker to the related Contact's RecordTypes_related__c based on the Opportunity record type. Note: one-off backfill that already ran; dead but still Active.
Opp_Keyword_Notes_Contact_Flow: On Opportunity create/update by anyone except System Administrators, sets Contacted__c to true when Jungo_Notes__c contains keywords like itin, tax, credit, cash, zelle, trabajo or social. Note: no entry criteria and loose substrings (e.g. 'cia') cause frequent self-updates and false matches.
Opportunity_Stage_Date_Tracker_Create: On Opportunity creation, sets StageName to 'Proposal' for Entity loans (Loan_Program__c = F30EEP); otherwise stamps today into Pre_Qualified_Doc_requested_Date__c, Qualification_Date__c and DateInviteSent__c.
Opt_In_and_Opt_Out_for_Zoom: When an SMS Task whose subject contains 'Messages between' has its Description changed, asynchronously calls Apex TaskMessageProcessorFlow to apply opt-in/opt-out consent to the related Lead/Opportunity. Note: fault path silently swallows failures, so consent changes can be lost quietly.
Original_Est_Closing_Date_Update: Before an Opportunity is saved with a changed Application_Date__c, copies Est_Closing_Date__c into Org_Est_Closing_Date__c to preserve the original estimated closing date.
Prequalification_Form: Bilingual screen flow where staff capture a borrower prequalification; it creates or updates the Borrower Lead (matched by email or phone), writes the required-documents list, and creates a 'Collect documents' Mortgage_Condition__c work item.
Realtor_AI_Profile: When AI_Trigger__c becomes true on a Lead of record type 012Kb000000RpDDIA0 or 012Kb000000RpDCIA0, sets AI_Status__c to Pending and asynchronously posts the Lead's contact details to a Make.com webhook. Note: the external callout has no fault path.
Recruitment_Rule_Opportunity: Before-save on B2B Opportunities (RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDHIA0) when created or NPPM/Recruitment Role changes; blocks the save unless Recruitment Role matches NPPM (checked: Realtor-BD/Realtor-NPPM; unchecked: blank/Realtor).
Recruitment_Rule_Opportunity_Contact_Syn: After-save on B2B Opportunities (RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDHIA0) with a Contact when Recruitment Role changes; copies Recruitment_Role__c onto the related Contact.
Recruitment_Rule_Validation: Before-save on Leads of RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDDIA0 (create/update); blocks the save unless Recruitment Role matches NPPM (checked: Realtor-BD/Realtor-NPPM; unchecked: blank/Realtor).
Reset_stage_by_hierarchy: After-save on Opportunity stage change; if the stage moves backwards (e.g. from Closed Won/Lost, Negotiation or Proposal to an earlier stage), it reverts StageName (and loss reason) to the prior value. Note: only runs when the editing user's email equals a hard-coded integration address, despite the 'No is administrator' label; logic looks inverted.
SLA_Aging_5PM: Scheduled daily at 17:00 over open touch Tasks with an Assigned Date; computes business hours since assignment and sets SLA__c to an aging bucket (Under 24/24+/48+/72+ Hours), clearing SLA_Missed_By__c. Note: identical copy of SLA_Aging_9AM and SLA_Task_Aging except run time.
SLA_Aging_9AM: Scheduled daily at 09:00 over open touch Tasks with an Assigned Date; computes business hours since assignment and sets SLA__c to an aging bucket (Under 24/24+/48+/72+ Hours), clearing SLA_Missed_By__c. Note: identical copy of SLA_Aging_5PM and SLA_Task_Aging except run time.
SLA_Follow_Ups: After-save when a touch Task is marked Completed; records SLA met/missed (24h first touch, 48h follow-up) and hours missed, then for non-document tasks on unconverted Leads creates a new Follow Up Task due in 2 business days.
SLA_Task_Aging: Scheduled daily at 13:00 over open touch Tasks with an Assigned Date; computes business hours since assignment and sets SLA__c to an aging bucket (Under 24/24+/48+/72+ Hours), clearing SLA_Missed_By__c. Note: identical copy of SLA_Aging_5PM and SLA_Aging_9AM except run time.
Sales_Agent_First_Follow_Up: After-save on Lead when Sales_Agent__c is set/changed; creates an open 'First Touch' Task for the sales agent due next business day and stamps Sales_Agent_Assignment_Date__c.
Search_lead_discarded_Don_t_want_to_be_c: Before-save on Lead create; blocks the new Lead with an error if a Discarded Lead with reason 'Don't want to be contacted' exists in the same branch with the same email or phone.
Send_notification_sms_360: After-save on each new incoming SMS 360 message (tdc_tsw__Message__c, non-group-chat); sends a 'New message' bell notification to the related Lead owner (plus co-owner) or Opportunity owner. Note: co-owner check reads Lead__r.Co_Owner__c while the recipient uses tdc_tsw__Lead__r, so co-owner routing may never fire.
Set_Has_AI_Followup_Request: Before-save on every Lead create/update; sets Has_AI_Followup_Request__c true when AI_Followup_Request__c is filled, otherwise false.
Set_Lead_Importance: Before-save on Facebook-sourced Leads of RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDAIA0 with Income over 70,000 and Lead Importance blank or Low; raises Lead_Importance__c to Medium.
Social_Media_Leads_Alerts_and_Updates: After-save on Lead; emails a new-Facebook-lead alert when campaign becomes 'bullmortgage_leadgen', and sets Referred_By__c to a fixed Contact when campaign becomes 'monica_manosalva_jcgr'. Note: email goes to a hard-coded personal address, Referred By uses a hard-coded Contact Id, and the send has no fault path.
Sync_Due_Date_for_Tasks: Before-save on Task when Due_Date_Time__c or ActivityDate changes; keeps them in sync, copying the due datetime into ActivityDate or rebuilding Due_Date_Time__c from ActivityDate plus existing or current time.
Update_Lead_Status_When_Task_Created: After-save on new Task tied to a Lead (excluding two marketing email subjects); if the branch Lead is New and owned by the task creator, sets Lead Status to Working.
Update_Lifecycle_on_base_the_Stage_Oppor: Before-save on B2B Opportunities (RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDHIA0); sets LIfecycle_stage__c from StageName: Qualification/Needs Analysis=MQL, Proposal=SQL, Negotiation=OPP, Closed Won=Customer.
Update_Pre_approved_date_current_status: After-save on Opportunities of RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDEIA0 with Current Status Pre-Approved; stamps Pre_Approved_Date__c with today if it was previously blank.
Update_Ratified_date_current_status: Before-save on Opportunities of RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDEIA0 with an Application Date; sets Ratified_Date__c to Sales_Contract_Ratified_Date__c if present, otherwise to Application_Date__c.
Update_change_owner_date: Before-save on Lead when the owner changes or change_owner_date__c is blank; stamps change_owner_date__c with the current datetime.
Update_current_status_by_new_or_closed_s: After-save on Opportunity at Qualification, Closed Won or Closed Lost; for RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDEIA0 at Qualification with no prior status, sets Current_Status__c to 'Pre-Qualified/Doc Requested'. Note: Closed Won/Lost enter the flow but have no branch, so nothing happens for them.
Update_field_lead_importance: After-save on every Lead update; sets Lead_Importance__c to Low for RecordTypeId 012Kb000000RpDAIA0 Leads Discarded for Lack of Income or Unqualified Contact Information when importance is blank.
Update_team_member_users_create_update: After-save on OpportunityTeamMember create/update; clears and rebuilds the parent Opportunity's Opportunity_Team__c rich-text list of team member names and roles.
Update_team_member_users_delete: Before an Opportunity Team Member is deleted, rebuilds the parent Opportunity's Opportunity_Team__c text from the remaining members (clears it when none remain). Note: described from the ACTIVE v1; the newest version is an Obsolete test draft.
add_lead_to_campaign: When a Lead with leadCapture__c = true is created, sets Company/LeadSource=Facebook/Media=Paid/record type, adds it to the campaign named in Campaign_name__c (Responded), and assigns the owner based on campaign name. Note: owners are looked up by hard-coded user email addresses and hard-coded campaign names (including a test-looking one); the campaign-member create has no fault path.
branch_default_when_Lead_create: Before a Lead is saved with a changed owner or blank Branch__c, sets Branch__c to a branch code chosen by matching the owner's email against a hard-coded list. Note: hard-coded user email addresses drive the mapping, and one branch value is the suspicious 'ab'.
branch_default_when_Opp_create: Before an Opportunity is saved with a changed owner or blank Branch__c, sets Branch__c to a branch code chosen by matching the owner's email against a hard-coded list. Note: hard-coded user email addresses drive the mapping.
change_owner_Opps: Screen flow that takes a list of selected Opportunity Ids, lets the user pick an active User, and sets that user as OwnerId on all of them.
change_owner_to_duplicate_leads_no_borro: When a non-borrower Lead is updated to Status Discarded with reason 'Duplicate Lead' and has an original Lead or Opportunity, reassigns its owner to one fixed user. Note: the new owner is a hard-coded user Id (005Kb00000B1ZEt).
change_stage_Opps: Screen flow that takes a list of selected Opportunity Ids, lets the user pick an Opportunity stage, and sets that StageName on all of them.
clear_recordType_related: Scheduled flow that ran once on 2025-04-14 and blanked RecordTypes_related__c on every Contact. Note: one-time job already executed; it is dead but still active.
customer_satisfaction: Salesforce Survey asking customers to rate the service from 1 (Bad) to 5 (Good) and leave optional comments; it changes no records itself.
hasTaxID: When an Opportunity is saved with SSN_ITIN__c starting with 9 (an ITIN), sets TaxID__c = true.
net_promoter_score: Salesforce Survey that asks a 0-10 'how likely are you to recommend us' NPS question plus an optional free-text comment; it changes no records itself.
not_allow_to_create_non_borrowers_leads: Blocks creation of a non-Borrower (RT not 012Kb000000RpDAIA0) Lead that is Discarded as 'Duplicate Lead' with an Original Lead/Opportunity, showing an error with a link to the original record. Note: error links hard-code the prod domain.
